name: Yakushima Karen
source:
A first-year student at Kayo Academy.
Yakushima Shuuji step-sister.

She has a calm and gentle personality, but when it comes to her brother, she shows a domineering and arrogant disposition.

Although she is still a virgin, her body is well developed because she repeatedly masturbates thinking of her brother.
